title: Mission Arena
subtitle: Escort / infiltrate sim — no live radio
subtitle_gmaps: Built on repo Google Maps (MapView) · multi-UAV factions · observer camera
subtitle_cesium: Cesium 3D · multi-stage war · dual routes / relay / ambush
brief_fallback: Contact→clash→assault→endgame. VIP can switch south route; relay is contestable; Red ambush + Blue picket.
rule_blue: Blue: lead intercepts, wing duels, guard holds relay then screens VIP.
rule_red: Red: hunter/flanker/jammer/ambusher. Occupy, jam, break VIP, or steal relay.
rule_observer: Scout in 3D; press 2 to pilot blue lead. Stages trigger ambush and reinforcements.
rule_keys3d: 1 observer · 2 blue · V follow · Space start · Esc abort
follow_cam: Camera follows active unit (observer / blue lead)
fpv_hint_gmaps: Altitude maps to zoom (like /map); tilt/heading via sliders or Q/E; satellite supports tilt
overlay_hint_cesium: Same Cesium 3D as Node 1. Drag left GIMBAL or use look buttons for free yaw/pitch; right stick flies the observer.
overlay_hint_gmaps: Same Google Maps basemap as the repo.
replay_hint: Mission ended. Review the log, then run again.
need_google_key: A valid Google Maps API key is required (same as /map). Set googleApiKey in client/config.json with Maps JavaScript API enabled.
